signal.ACCOUNT_HANDLING: Offers to trade your account for you; this is not allowed.
signal.APP_CLAIMS_BROKER_NOT_LISTED: This app is not on the exchange's list of broker apps.
signal.APP_DEVELOPER_MISMATCH: The app's developer name does not match the broker's.
signal.APP_IN_BROKER_REGISTRY: This app is on the exchange's broker-app list.
signal.APP_NOT_ON_PLAY: This app is not on the Google Play Store.
signal.APP_SEBI_VERIFIED: Shows the Play Store's "Verified" label for brokers.
signal.BANK_NOT_BANK_IN: A real bank's website must end in .bank.in.
signal.CELEBRITY_ENDORSEMENT: Claims a famous person endorses this; that is usually faked.
signal.CRYPTO_PAYMENT_REQUEST: Asks you to pay into a crypto wallet.
signal.DABBA: This is off-exchange "dabba" trading; it has no protection.
signal.DEBARRED_ENTITY: SEBI has barred this entity from the market.
signal.DIGITAL_ARREST: Threatens arrest to scare you into paying.
signal.DOMAIN_LOOKALIKE: This address looks like an official one but is not.
signal.DOMAIN_OLD: This website has existed for years.
signal.DOMAIN_UNPOPULAR_FOR_BRAND: Almost no one visits this site, for a brand this big.
signal.DOMAIN_YOUNG: This website was registered only recently.
signal.FAKE_HELPLINE: This is not an official helpline number.
signal.FAKE_REGULATOR_NOTICE: This copies the look of an official regulator's notice.
signal.FEE_TO_WITHDRAW: Asks for a fee before you can withdraw your money.
signal.FOREIGN_NUMBER_OFFICIAL_CLAIM: Claims to be an Indian regulated entity, calling from a foreign number.
signal.FREE_HOSTED_LANDING: This page is on a free website-building service.
signal.GOVT_NOT_GOV_IN: A real government website ends in .gov.in, not this.
signal.GUARANTEED_RETURN: Promises a guaranteed return; no one can promise that.
signal.HANDLE_LOOKALIKE_OFFICIAL: This handle imitates an official account.
signal.HEADER_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: This message's sender code doesn't match a real bank or broker.
signal.IMPOSSIBLE_RETURN: This rate would turn ₹10,000 into crores; that's impossible.
signal.INJECTION_TEXT: This message tries to instruct an automatic checker; ignored.
signal.INSTITUTIONAL_ACCESS: Offers special institutional access that isn't real for retail investors.
signal.LIVE_CALLS: Gives live trading calls without SEBI registration.
signal.MOBILE_SENDER_FOR_BANK: A bank message from an ordinary mobile number is unusual.
signal.OFFICIAL_DOMAIN_SPOOF: This copies the look of an official website.
signal.OFFICIAL_HELPLINE: This is an official helpline number.
signal.ON_CAUTION_LIST: This is on an exchange's official caution list.
signal.OTP_REQUEST: Asks for your OTP, PIN, password or wallet recovery phrase.
signal.PROMO_140_FOR_SERVICE: This number is for promotions, not for service calls.
signal.PUMP_LANGUAGE: Uses language common in stock price-rigging scams.
signal.QR_MCC_NOT_SECURITIES: This QR is not coded for securities payments.
signal.QR_P2P_FOR_BUSINESS: This QR is a personal code, not a business one.
signal.QR_PAYEE_NAME_MISMATCH: The name on this QR does not match who they claim to be.
signal.QR_UNSIGNED: This QR code is not digitally signed.
signal.REGULATED_CALL_NOT_1600: Regulated callers must use a 1600 number; this one doesn't.
signal.REG_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: This number is registered for a different type of work.
signal.REG_CLAIM_NOT_FOUND: No SEBI-registered entity matches this name.
signal.REG_CLAIM_NO_NUMBER: Says "SEBI registered" but gives no registration number.
signal.REG_EXPIRED: This registration is no longer valid.
signal.REG_FORMAT_INVALID: This registration number is not in a valid SEBI format.
signal.REG_NAME_MISMATCH: This registration number belongs to a different name.
signal.REG_NOT_FOUND: This registration number is not in SEBI's register.
signal.REMOTE_ACCESS_REQUEST: Asks you to install an app that controls your phone remotely.
signal.SENSITIVE_DATA_SHARED: Sensitive personal documents were shared over chat.
signal.SERIES_1600: Called from a registered 1600 service number.
signal.SIDELOAD_APK: This is a direct app file, not from an app store.
signal.UNSOLICITED_CONTACT: You were contacted out of the blue.
signal.UPI_COLLECT_TO_RECEIVE: Approving this would send money out, not bring it in.
signal.UPI_HANDLE_UNKNOWN: We don't recognise this UPI handle's bank.
signal.UPI_PERSONAL_WHILE_CLAIMING_SEBI: Claims SEBI registration but asks for payment to a personal UPI ID.
signal.UPI_VALID_CATEGORY_MISMATCH: This UPI ID's category does not match what they claim to be.
signal.UPI_VALID_HANDLE: This is a SEBI @valid UPI handle.
signal.URGENCY: Pushes you to act fast, with no time to think.
signal.URL_KNOWN_PHISHING: This link is on a known phishing list.
signal.URL_SHORTENED: This is a shortened link; the real address is hidden.
signal.VIP_GROUP: Invites you to a "VIP" tips group.
signal.KYC_PHISHING: Asks you to verify PAN, Aadhaar or KYC through a link or chat
signal.ADVANCE_FEE: Asks for a fee to release an allotment, prize or offer
signal.AI_RISK_PATTERN: Satark AI found a risky pattern in this message
